# Permissions and API key scopes

Every operation, over MCP or HTTP, is gated on a `resource:action` permission. A session gets its permissions from the member's role; an API key gets them from the scopes chosen when it was minted. A key minted with no scopes has the workspace's full authority.

A `forbidden` error (HTTP 403) means the credential lacks the permission named here. Nothing else fixes it: a new key with the missing scope, or a role change for the session.

Roles nest strictly: owner ⊃ admin ⊃ manager ⊃ member.

| Permission | owner | admin | manager | member |
| --- | :-: | :-: | :-: | :-: |
| `organization:read` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `organization:update` | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |
| `organization:delete` | ✓ |  |  |  |
| `member:read` | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| `member:create` | ✓ | ✓ |  |  |
